summary: Iteration 315 - UI/UX Enhancements Testing (1mg/Blinkit inspired). All 8 test cases passed (100%). Features tested: Homepage hero carousel with promotional text overlays and auto-rotation, Savings counter with animated number display, Enhanced global search with recent searches/trending/quick actions, Pharmacy Deals of the Day with countdown timer and Add to Cart, localStorage persistence for recent searches.

findings: Hero carousel found (data-testid='nevika-cura-ad-banner')
Promotional text overlays present: 'Free delivery on orders above ₹999', 'Flat 15% off on first medicine order', 'Lab tests at home — Book now', 'CuraOne members save up to 25%'
4 dot indicators present for navigation
Auto-rotation working (scroll position changed to 1216px after 5 seconds)
Gradient overlay on banners for text readability
Savings counter found (data-testid='savings-counter')
Savings amount displayed: ₹385 (calculated from nc_order_savings + curaCoins)
Animated counter on load (eased animation over 1.2s)
Green gradient background with trophy icon
Counter hidden when savings=0
Global search input found (data-testid='global-search-input')
Full-screen suggestions panel appears on focus (data-testid='search-suggestions')
Recent searches section with Clear button (data-testid='clear-recent-searches')
Trending search chips: Paracetamol, CBC Test, Thyroid Profile, Vitamin D, Blood Sugar, Azithromycin
Quick actions section with 4 service shortcuts
Clicking trending chip populates search query
Recent searches persist in localStorage (nc_recent_searches key)
Clear button removes recent searches from localStorage
Deals of the Day section found (data-testid='deals-of-the-day')
Countdown timer showing time until midnight (data-testid='deal-countdown')
Deals scroller with horizontal scroll (data-testid='deals-scroller')
2 deal cards found with discount badges (24% OFF)
Add to Cart button works (data-testid='deal-add-{idx}')
Toast notification 'Added to cart' appears
Quantity controls appear after adding to cart
View cart button shows item count
Health Insights button navigates to /health-insights
Adult Vaccination button navigates to /adult-vaccination
Cart page loads with product suggestions
All navigation working correctly

critical_code_review_comments: Hero carousel uses NC_SLIDES array with 4 promotional banners and gradient text overlays
SavingsCounter calculates from nc_order_savings localStorage + curaCoins/10 estimate
GlobalSearch implements full-screen takeover UX with recent/trending/quick actions
DealsOfTheDay fetches from /api/pharmacy/trending and calculates synthetic deal prices for items with mrp=0
All data-testids properly implemented for automated testing
localStorage persistence working correctly for nc_recent_searches
seed_data_creation: Injected test data via localStorage: nc_order_savings (savings array), curaCoins ('350'), nc_recent_searches (search history)
context_for_next_testing_agent: New UI/UX enhancements added: 1) Homepage hero carousel with promotional text overlays (data-testid: nevika-cura-ad-banner), auto-rotates every 4 seconds with dot indicators. 2) SavingsCounter component (data-testid: savings-counter, savings-amount) shows monthly savings from nc_order_savings localStorage. 3) Enhanced GlobalSearch (data-testid: global-search, global-search-input, search-suggestions, clear-recent-searches, recent-search-{idx}, trending-search-{idx}, quick-action-{idx}) with full-screen takeover showing recent searches, trending chips, and quick actions. 4) Pharmacy DealsOfTheDay (data-testid: deals-of-the-day, deal-countdown, deals-scroller, deal-card-{idx}, deal-add-{idx}) with countdown timer to midnight and Add to Cart functionality.
